description: Where the agents' accounts are: the hosts the fabric operates, and which host each login was provisioned on (placement). A host's id is its short hostname — what runtime/identity.py current_host() returns and what a GZCoord address carries — so two hosts can never share one, and a worker that reports another name than the id it was reached as is refused. `ssh` is how the coordinator reaches the host's operator account (an ssh destination; null for the host the coordinator runs on, reached directly), `operator` the login there that holds sudo and the fabric checkout at `fabric`, and `operator_key` (`ed25519:<base64 SPKI>`, written by `fabric-ctl keygen`) the public half of that operator's signing key — every control daemon answers a control-plane ACTION only when signed with it (runtime/control/sign.mjs). Placement is where an account lives, never its identity (the OS's) and never its role.
